page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.xlarge is a high clock speed virtual instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance configuration provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, alongside 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 33 MB L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector features including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 extensions, AES cryptographic support, and BMI2 instructions.

The hardware configuration pairs these 4 vCPUs with 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent data operations, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Graphical accelerators are omitted, reflecting a pure CPU and memory operational profile.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent single-thread execution, supported by the 3.3 GHz nominal clock rate. The instance registered average performance in stress-ng single-core tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and Geekbench single-core evaluations. However, overall multi-threaded throughput is constrained by the 4 vCPU topology, showing weak relative scores across PassMark CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core workloads, and Redis SET operations. Memory throughput tests recorded 30.79 GB/sec for uncached read-only streams and 25.45 GB/sec for uncached writes.

From an architectural standpoint, the ecs.hfr7.xlarge delivers substantial RAM density paired with stable single-core computing capabilities, balanced against lower aggregate parallel compute throughput. It is technically suitable for memory-sensitive enterprise applications, in-memory caching layers, medium-scale relational databases, and single-threaded batch processing tasks that do not depend on high network bandwidth or integrated local NVMe disks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.xlarge is a memory-oriented, high clock speed virtual machine running on KVM. Driven by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB x86_64 processor, the configuration provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores, accompanied by 32.0 GB of RAM. The instance features modern instruction support including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16. It includes no bundled local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps without GPU acceleration. Across synthetic benchmarks, the instance achieves average single-thread processing marks, though its 4-thread execution cap limits multi-core computational and compilation throughput. With an 8.0 GB per core resource distribution, the ecs.hfr7.xlarge is suited for memory-intensive services, caching instances, and single-threaded enterprise operations that require ample memory headroom without extreme parallel processing requirements.
